units.zh: 亚太经合组织互联互通蓝图
units.en: APEC Connectivity Blueprint

units.zh: 我们强调，互联互通促进本地区商品、服务、资金和人员流动，有助于密切经济联系、推动长期经济增长；我们以《2040年亚太经合组织布特拉加亚愿景》为指引，朝着建设开放、活力、强韧、和平的亚太共同体迈进，实现亚太人民和子孙后代的共同繁荣。
units.en: We underscore that connectivity facilitates the flow of goods, services, capital, and people across the region. It helps to foster closer economic ties and enable long-term economic growth, towards building an open, dynamic, resilient and peaceful Asia-Pacific community, for the prosperity of all our people and future generations, guided by the APEC Putrajaya Vision 2040.

units.zh: 我们肯定《亚太经合组织互联互通蓝图（2015－2025）》十年来为推进互联互通合作发挥的作用。新兴趋势和不断演变的需求正在重塑本地区互联互通格局。我们鼓励各经济体继续努力，朝着实现无缝、全面联通和融合亚太的远景目标迈进。
units.en: We recognize the role of the APEC Connectivity Blueprint (2015-2025) in support of cooperation to advance connectivity over the past decade. As emerging trends and evolving demands reshape the region’s connectivity landscape, we encourage economies to continue efforts towards aspirational goal of achieving a seamlessly and comprehensively connected and integrated Asia-Pacific region.

units.zh: 支柱一：硬联通
units.en: Pillar 1: Physical

units.zh: 目标：鼓励各经济体通过创新和应用现代技术建设、维护并升级高质量基础设施，提升硬联通水平。
units.en: Objective: enhance physical connectivity by encouraging economies to develop, maintain and upgrade quality infrastructure, including through innovation and adoption of modern technologies.

units.zh: 加强陆上、海上、航空互联互通，通过交通联接提升区域互联互通水平。
units.en: Strengthen land, maritime, and air connectivity with transport links to enhance regional connectivity.

units.zh: 推动交通运输领域创新与数字化转型，探索安全可靠的自动驾驶、无人技术等新兴出行解决方案，开展自愿知识交流，分享相关经验和良好实践，以提升对新兴技术的适应能力。
units.en: Advance innovation and digital transformation in the transport sector, and explore safe and secure autonomous and unmanned technologies and emerging mobility solutions, including through voluntary knowledge exchange, and sharing of relevant experiences and best practices to strengthen readiness for emerging technologies.

units.zh: 推动海运、航空和多式联运安全高效运行，便利人员和货物流动。
units.en: Promote safe and efficient operation of maritime, air and intermodal connectivity to facilitate the movement of people and goods.

units.zh: 在可行且互利的前提下，推进能源基础设施互联互通，促进能源运输与贸易，增强关键能源基础设施和供应链的可靠性、安全性和韧性，维护能源安全，推动高质量能源普遍可及，同时促进技术创新。
units.en: Support energy infrastructure interconnectivity where feasible and beneficial, facilitate energy transmission and trade, enhance the reliability, security and resilience of critical energy infrastructure and supply chains, to promote energy security and universal access to high-quality energy, while enabling technological innovation.

units.zh: 鼓励建设可靠、可扩展、可信赖、安全且有韧性的通信基础设施；向农村及偏远地区拓展可接入网络，提升全民数字服务可及性；鼓励合作，为包括低地球轨道卫星在内的下一代互联互通技术和服务营造有利环境；升级数字基础设施，以更高能效和资源利用效率满足不断增长的需求；推动现有基础设施数字化，提高运营效率与服务供给能力。
units.en: Encourage the development of reliable, scalable, trusted, secure and resilient communication infrastructure; extend accessible networks to rural and remote areas, and improve access to digital services for all; encourage cooperation to support an enabling environment for next-generation connectivity technologies and services including low-earth orbit satellites; upgrade digital infrastructure to meet growing demands with higher energy and resource efficiency; promote digitalization of existing infrastructure to enhance operational efficiency and service delivery.

units.zh: 构建全生态协同模式，调动公共部门、私营部门和多边开发银行资源，识别并弥合基础设施融资缺口。
units.en: Identify and address infrastructure financing gaps through developing a whole-of-ecosystem approach that mobilizes resources from the public sector, the private sector, and multilateral development banks (MDBs).

units.zh: 提升基础设施项目的规划和实施水平，纳入韧性措施、减灾事前投资和全周期成本考量。
units.en: Enhance planning and implementing infrastructure projects, incorporating resilience measures, ex-ante investment in disaster risk reduction, and lifecycle cost considerations.

units.zh: 支柱二：软联通
units.en: Pillar 2: Institutional

units.zh: 目标：鼓励各经济体减少制度性壁垒，促进贸易和投资，推动建立更加紧密的区域经济。
units.en: Objective: encourage economies to reduce institutional barriers, in advancement of trade and investment, and contributing to a more connected regional economy.

units.zh: 通过技术与创新、边境机构合作、适当的查验、自动化风险管理以及简化通关手续，推动海关程序现代化。
units.en: Modernize customs procedures through technology and innovation, border agency cooperation, appropriate inspection, automated risk management, and streamlined clearance procedures.

units.zh: 开展结构性改革，激发增长活力，降低不必要监管负担，营造有利且有竞争力的营商环境，继续推进《亚太经合组织强化和提升结构性改革议程（2026－2030）》和《亚太经合组织改善营商环境行动计划（第四期）》。
units.en: Undertake structural reforms to stimulate growth, reduce unnecessary regulatory burdens, foster an enabling and competitive business environment, and continue to advance the Strengthened and Enhanced APEC Agenda for Structural Reform (SEAASR) 2026-2030 and APEC’s Fourth Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) Action Plan.

units.zh: 鼓励在共同关心的领域深化技术标准交流与合作，肯定良好监管实践对提升透明度、可预见性和效率的价值。
units.en: Encourage deepened exchange and cooperation on technical standards in sectors of mutual interest, and recognize the value of implementing good regulatory practices to foster transparency, predictability and efficiency in the regulatory environment.

units.zh: 取消贸易投资领域“边境后”壁垒，简化相关程序，提升效率、营商便利度、生产率和竞争力。
units.en: Address behind-the-border barriers to trade and investment, streamline related procedures to enhance efficiency, ease of doing business, productivity, and competitiveness.

units.zh: 提升供应链互联互通水平，通过破解供应链堵点、增强韧性、提升运行效率、最大限度减少中断、强化价值链，包括依托《亚太经合组织供应链互联互通框架行动计划》等相关机制开展合作。
units.en: Improve supply chain connectivity by addressing chokepoints, enhancing resilience, boosting operational efficiency, minimizing disruptions, and strengthening value chains, including through leveraging relevant APEC works, such as the APEC Supply Chain Connectivity Framework Action Plan (SCFAP).

units.zh: 发挥数字及其他新兴技术作用，促进贸易数字化。
units.en: Promote trade digitalization by harnessing digital and other emerging technologies.

units.zh: 强化数据对经济增长和数字创新的支撑作用，鼓励采取措施促进数据流动，包括通过亚太经合组织跨境隐私规则体系，增进企业和消费者对数字交易的信任，同时确保数据保护、尊重隐私和知识产权。
units.en: Strengthen the enabling role of data for economic growth and digital innovation, encourage efforts to promote  flow of data, including via the APEC Cross-Border Privacy Rules (CBPR) System, while strengthening business and consumer trust in digital transactions, and ensuring respect for data protection, privacy and intellectual property rights.

units.zh: 提升金融互联互通，促进区域资本流动，包括推动资本市场发展、基础设施融资和防范灾害风险融资。
units.en: Enhance financial connectivity to support the flow of capital across the region, including by promoting capital market development, infrastructure financing and disaster risk finance.

units.zh: 支柱三：心联通
units.en: Pillar 3: People-to-people

units.zh: 目标：通过促进商务人员流动，以及教育、旅游、人力资源开发和创新合作，加强惠及所有人的互联互通。
units.en: Objective: facilitate connectivity that benefits all through business mobility, education, tourism, human resource development, and innovation cooperation.

units.zh: 促进商务人员流动，用好亚太经合组织商务旅行卡，鼓励商旅卡计划正式成员经济体接纳和使用亚太经合组织虚拟商务旅行卡。
units.en: Facilitate business mobility, including through APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC) and encourage fully participating economies’ uptake and acceptance of the virtual ABTC.

units.zh: 肯定应对非正常移民流动的重要性。
units.en: Recognize the importance of addressing irregular migration flows.

units.zh: 加强教育、职业培训、技能提升等领域交流，探索科研人员流动，支持终身学习。
units.en: Strengthen education, vocational training, skills development exchanges, explore academic mobility and support lifelong learning.

units.zh: 支持社会各界参与数字经济合作，提升数字素养，让数字转型成果惠及全民，包括开展能力建设，出台提升数字素养与数字能力的政策，为劳动者全职业生涯提供技能提升和再培训机会。
units.en: Support participation in the digital economy, enhance digital literacy and make the benefits of digital transformation accessible to all, including through capacity building, policies that build digital literacy and competencies, and opportunities for upskilling and reskilling throughout working life.

units.zh: 赋能中小微企业，助力其参与价值链，包括营造有利营商环境，提升其创新能力、发展能力与专业水平，取消繁琐和不必要的监管，推动非正规中小微企业向正规和全球经济转型。
units.en: Empower MSMEs and facilitate their participation in value chains, by fostering an enabling business environment, elevating their innovation, capabilities, and expertise, eliminating burdensome and unnecessary regulations, as well as promoting informal MSME’s transition from the informal to the formal and global economies.

units.zh: 调动劳动力市场各方力量，扶持创业，创造更多经济机遇，促进高质量充分和生产性就业，加强终身学习，拓宽技能提升和再培训机会，保护工人权利，在不断变化的劳动世界中继续提升国际劳工标准。
units.en: Engage all segments of the labor market, support entrepreneurship, create more economic opportunities, promote access to high-quality,  full and productive employment, strengthen lifelong learning and access to upskilling and reskilling opportunities, protect the rights of workers and continue our efforts to promote international labor standards in the changing world of work.

units.zh: 通过建设有韧性的就业和教育体系，强化劳动力需求与技能预测研判，塑造现代化人力资源开发，通过提升医疗服务可及性等扩大劳动力市场参与度，帮助劳动者应对人口结构变化。
units.en: Prepare the workforce for demographic changes by building resilient employment and education systems, strengthening work-force demand and skills forecasting, modernizing human resources development, and expanding labour market participation including by expanding access to healthcare.

units.zh: 促进文化交流与旅游便利化，利用数字技术提升旅游业效率、能力与生产力。
units.en: Promote cultural exchanges and tourism facilitation, leverage digital technologies to enhance the efficiency, capacity, and productivity of the tourism sector.

units.zh: 构建有竞争力的创新生态；鼓励根据双方同意的条件，自愿开展知识共享，增强地区创新能力与竞争力。
units.en: Foster a competitive innovation ecosystem; and encourage the voluntary sharing of knowledge on mutually agreed terms to boost the region’s innovation capacity and competitiveness.

units.zh: 实施
units.en: Implementation

units.zh: 鼓励各经济体根据各自情况通过亚太经合组织现有工作机制，进一步推进区域互联互通。也鼓励同相关利益攸关方开展跨机制协作。
units.en: Economies are encouraged to further advance connectivity in the region through existing APEC efforts and mechanisms, where appropriate. Cross-fora collaboration with relevant stakeholders is also encouraged.

units.zh: 2027至2030年，高官将在每年某一次高官会上讨论本蓝图落实情况，旨在更加深入地讨论这一事项。请亚太经合组织秘书处在高官会上通报相关机制及下设机制采取的行动和举措，并鼓励各经济体报告进展。
units.en: Senior Officials will discuss the implementation of this Blueprint during one of the Senior Officials’ Meetings once a year from 2027 to 2030, with a view to further discussing this issue as decided by Senior Officials. The APEC Secretariat is requested to provide updates on the actions and initiatives taken by relevant APEC fora and sub-fora, and economies are encouraged to report their progress during the Senior Officials’ Meetings.
